meta.title: MCP Market
meta.description: Discover MCP servers in the official MCP Registry, install one as a dsh-mcp-client row in the active profile, and enable or remove it later.

title: MCP Market
intro: Search the official MCP Registry or a custom market source; installed servers are written to the active profile and can be toggled here.
search.placeholder: Search MCP servers, for example github or filesystem…
search.label: Search MCP servers
state.discoverEmptyBody: Try another keyword, or clear the search to see the featured list.
state.installedEmptyBody: Pick one under Discover; it will appear here after installing.
state.errorBody: The data could not be fetched. Check the network and retry.
detail.installHint: Choose a connection and fill in any credentials. Installing writes a dsh-mcp-client row to the active profile.
detail.trust: Descriptions, links, and commands in the catalog come from third parties. Verify the source before installing; once connected, the MCP server can reach the network and local resources as you.
detail.runtimeMissing: The runtime command {command} is missing, so this package cannot be installed.
detail.existing: A server with this name is already installed. Continuing replaces its configuration.
detail.existingHint: Replacing only updates rows managed by this plugin and leaves other rows untouched.
detail.needsInput: This entry declares required command arguments without registry defaults, so it cannot be installed automatically yet.
detail.installApplied: Configuration applied. The MCP server should load within a few seconds.
detail.installRestart: Configuration written. Restart DSH for it to take effect.
detail.installNoTools: Once loaded, the server's tools appear in the model's tool list.
detail.notInstallable: This server offers no supported connection (SSE is not supported yet).
detail.noConfig: This entry has no installable configuration.
installed.title: Installed
installed.intro: Servers managed by this plugin, plus read-only rows discovered in the profile.
installed.hmrHint: HMR was not detected: configuration changes need a DSH restart to take effect.
installed.externalHint: These rows live outside the managed block and were written by you or another plugin; this plugin only reads them.
installed.removeBody: Removes "{name}" from the managed block and the MCP Market records. The server's own data is not deleted.
installed.noPatch: No patch file for the active profile was found, so MCP rows cannot be managed.
toast.restartRequired: Configuration written; restart DSH to apply
warning.insecureUrl: The endpoint uses HTTP; credentials may be exposed in transit.
warning.secretInProfile: Credentials are stored in plain text in the active profile's cordis.patch.yml (mode 0600).
warning.unpinnedVersion: The package version is not pinned (latest) and may upgrade later.
warning.runtimeMissing: A required runtime command is missing, so installation is blocked.
warning.unsupported: This server only offers SSE, which is not supported yet.
error.rateLimited: The MCP Registry is rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.
error.fetchFailed: Could not reach the MCP Registry. Check the network and retry.
error.notFound: This MCP server was not found.
error.invalidEntry: This entry's configuration is incomplete and cannot be installed.
error.needsInput: Some required fields are still empty.
error.alreadyInstalled: A server with this name is already installed.
error.invalidValue: A submitted value does not meet the requirements.
error.notManaged: That row is not managed by this plugin.
error.timeout: The request timed out. Try again.
sources.dialogIntro: Search, details, and install use the selected market source.
sources.builtinHint: The built-in source is always present and cannot be removed.
sources.indexHint: A JSON index must declare format: 1. Only JSON index sources accept a local path (absolute, ~/..., or file://). Installation re-reads the server entry from that source.
local.title: Add a local MCP server
local.subtitle: Point at an executable on this machine. The command runs without a shell; nothing is sent to a registry.
local.name: Server name (optional)
local.namePlaceholder: Generated from the command when empty
local.existing: A server with this name is already installed.
local.available: The command is available. Review the configuration before installing.
local.unavailable: The command {command} is missing; installation will be refused.
local.successApplied: Configuration applied. The MCP server should load within a few seconds.
local.successRestart: Configuration written. Restart DSH for it to take effect.
local.hint: Environment values are stored in the active profile. The command is spawned directly, never through a shell.
